goal: ci.yml gains an e2e job running bun run e2e within 10 minutes, a CI rule requires fix pull requests touching plugin runtime to change tests/e2e/ or declare e2e-exempt with a reason, and the legacy roadmap-e2e tests are renamed as contract tests (Spec D5, D8, D9) (Initiative e2e-release-gate slice S8; Spec docs/specs/e2e-release-gate.spec.md).

acceptance.assertion: .github/workflows/ci.yml defines a job named e2e that runs bun run e2e with timeout-minutes 10 beside the verify job; the legacy roadmap Plan tests live under contract-test names and pass. Done looks like: tests/ci-e2e-job-contract.test.ts asserts the job and the renamed tests/roadmap-plan-contract.test.ts passes.

scripts/check-e2e-escape-rule.ts decides: a fix-titled PR changing plugins/immune-brain/runtime without a tests/e2e/ change fails; the same PR with a tests/e2e/ change passes; with a body line e2e-exempt: <reason> passes; with e2e-exempt: and an empty reason fails; a non-fix title passes. Done looks like: tests/e2e-escape-rule.test.ts covers the five cases.
